items.myth: USA, UK and Canada are the only options
items.detail: Germany, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and more. Choose by course and budget.

items.myth: What's popular is best for me
items.detail: Cost, course, language and career plan. Everyone's answer is different.

items.fact: Look at the university and course
items.detail: It's the quality of the university and course that matters, not the country.

youtube.title: Are USA, UK and Canada the only options? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 myths about choosing a country. There are many more countries, like Germany, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand. Popular isn't always best, look at your own fit. And the quality of the university and course is what matters.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
